body: Lesson (Fable2, 2026-11-16/17, a repeated slip, three times). Never call termal_acknowledge_mailbox in the SAME parallel batch as termal_read_mailbox, and never with a placeholder receipt. The receipt only exists in the read result, so a parallel or placeholder ack is refused with 400 ("receipt was not issued to this participant"). Always read first, then acknowledge in a later call with the exact receipt from that read.
